description: Long-lived Desktop performance runtime gates. This layer proves preflight readiness, browser/Tauri DOM anchors, runtime cells, and the runtime matrix without using one runtime as evidence for another.

logic.question: Can each Desktop runtime cell report an explicit sampled, blocked, baseline-preflight-failure, or diagnostic-incomplete state?
logic.invariant: browser-gateway, tauri-webview, prod-preview, and offline-fixture evidence must remain separate; one runtime cell cannot impersonate another.
